subject: Medford Graduation Rate Decline
overview: Lisa Kingsley presented data showing a four-point drop in Medford's graduation rate and highlighted the increased risk for high-need students.

items.title: Graduation Rate Data Presentation
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley reported that Medford's graduation rate decreased from 90.8% to 86.2%, with a more pronounced decline among students with language, income, and learning challenges.
